categories.name: Observation / Environment Attacks
categories.description: Attacks embedded in web pages, visual observations, DOM/HTML content, or deceptive interface structures.

categories.name: Context / Data Attacks
categories.description: Attacks delivered through retrieved content, multi-source observations, emails, tool outputs, or other untrusted context.

categories.name: Tool / Action Attacks
categories.description: Attacks against tool descriptions, tool retrieval, action selection, or the invocation pipeline.

categories.name: Resource / Availability Attacks
categories.description: Attacks that increase computational cost, delay completion, or exhaust budget and runtime resources.

categories.name: Privacy / Side Channels
categories.description: Leakage through prompts, browsing patterns, traffic metadata, domains, timing, or local agent behavior.

categories.name: Defenses
categories.description: Runtime, causal, alignment, masking, sandboxing, or policy mechanisms for reducing agent compromise.

categories.name: Security Evaluation
categories.description: Benchmarks, environments, metrics, and evaluation protocols for Web Agent Security.
